search.query: index=notable eventtype="risk_notables" | stats count by source
index=risk NOT tag="QA" | stats count as events by source | sort - events
index=risk tag="QA" | stats count as events by source | sort - events

| makeresults | eval _time = null() | append [| loadjob "$risk_24hr_events$" | stats count by _time] | append [| loadjob "$risk_24hr_multidetect_events$" | stats count by _time] | stats sum(count) as count by _time
| makeresults | eval risk_objects = if(isint($ro_count$),"$ro_count$",0) | table risk_objects

| tstats summariesonly=t count values(All_Risk.risk_message) as risk_message values(All_Risk.risk_score) as risk_score values(source) as sources values(All_Risk.risk_object_type) as risk_object_type from datamodel=Risk.All_Risk where All_Risk.threat_object="$threat_token$" groupby All_Risk.risk_object _time span=30d | rename All_Risk.risk_object as risk_object | table * | eval risk_score = mvindex(risk_score,0) , risk_score=round(risk_score,0) , risk_message = mvindex(risk_message,0) , risk_message = risk_score." - ".risk_message | eventstats dc(risk_object) as ro_count dc(sources) as source_count sum(count) as num_objects | rename risk_message AS sample_message

table.title: No-QA Risk > 100 Events - click threat objects to investigate

search.query: | tstats `summariesonly` count as risk_event_count sum(All_Risk.calculated_risk_score) as risk_score, values(All_Risk.risk_message) as risk_message, sum(All_Risk.calculated_risk_score) as summed_risk_score, max(All_Risk.calculated_risk_score) as single_risk_score, values(All_Risk.annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_tactic_id) as annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_tactic_id, dc(All_Risk.annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_tactic_id) as mitre_tactic_id_count, values(All_Risk.annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_technique_id) as annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_technique_id, dc(All_Risk.annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_technique_id) as mitre_technique_id_count, values(All_Risk.tag) as tag, mode(All_Risk.risk_object) as risk_object, mode(All_Risk.risk_object) as all_risk_objects, values(All_Risk.cim_entity_zone) as cim_entity_zone, values(All_Risk.threat_object) as threat_object, values(All_Risk.threat_object_type) as threat_object_type, values(All_Risk.threat_object_info) as threat_object_info, dc(source) as source_count, FROM datamodel=Risk.All_Risk WHERE NOT All_Risk.tag="QA" by All_Risk.normalized_risk_object,All_Risk.risk_object_type, source, _time span=1d | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Risk")` | eval "annotations.mitre_attack"='annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_technique_id' | `get_risk_severity(risk_score)` | eval capped_risk_score=if(summed_risk_score < single_risk_score*2, summed_risk_score, single_risk_score*2) | stats values(*) as * sum(capped_risk_score) as capped_risk_score sum(summed_risk_score) as summed_risk_score dc(annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_tactic_id) as mitre_tactic_id_count dc(annotations.mitre_attack.mitre_technique_id) as mitre_technique_id_count sum(risk_event_count) as risk_event_count dc(source) as source_count BY normalized_risk_object risk_object_type _time | fields - single_risk_score count | eval risk_score = capped_risk_score | eval risk_object_system = if(risk_object_type="system",normalized_risk_object,null()) | eval risk_object_user = if(risk_object_type="user",normalized_risk_object,null()) | where capped_risk_score > 100
